slides.texte_overlay:
9 Beautiful quotes that'll
change your perspective

You're not behind.
You're on a road
nobody else has walked.

The stairs don't get shorter.
Your legs get stronger.

Some doors close
so you'll finally look
at the window.

Discipline is just
remembering what you want
when it's hard to.

Curiosity is the cheapest
way to stay young.
Learn one new thing today.

slides.texte_overlay:
The best part of getting lost
is the road you find
on the way back.

Nobody remembers
how many times you fell.
They remember you got up.

Quiet isn't empty.
It's where you finally
hear yourself.

You can't rush seasons.
But you can be ready
when yours comes.
